label: Text 1
transcript: Jonas's class is voting on a new rule: no phones at lunch. Half the class is for it. The other half thinks it is mostly aimed at one group of students who happen to be loud anyway. Hawa says, "If I were the headteacher, I would ask why we are voting on phones and not on actual fairness."
